coverage.note: points are computed from finishing positions; the sources do not print them

method.clinch: the leader clinches when no rival can reach their total, counting the points the class can still score per round; a rival who can only tie must also beat the countback
method.scoring: both motos score; a DNF scores 0 and still counts as a moto started
method.tiebreak: points, then countback (most wins, then most seconds, and so on), then rider id
